If Your Order Hasn't Shipped Yet
Contact our team to cancel your current order, and once confirmed, you can place a new order for the size or option you want.
If Your Order Has Already Shipped or Been Delivered
Our team will help coordinate both the return and the new order:
Support team will arrange the return or donation pickup of your original item and process the refund once it's completed
Sales team can help you place a new order for the size or option you want, and they'll assist with discount matching from your original order
Important things to know:
You'll need to place a separate new order — funds from the original order can't be transferred directly
Different sizes may have different prices
The original order won't be refunded until the item has been returned or donated
